title: Treasury liquidity-support buyback operation (1Mo-2Y nominal, $4B cap, 1:40pm ET) — the only $4B sector that fills
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Buyback Operations (August 2026 refunding, masthead 'For Publication August 5, 2026'), PDF text layer decompressed direct 2026-09-08 by this event's own initial research (plain curl, HTTP 200, 125,547 bytes, md5 79b65955e74a59f6bebff3adf8ba7b35 — byte-identical to the 09-03/09-05/09-06/09-08 fetches four sibling lanes logged) — the row reads verbatim announce 11/4/2026, operation 11/5/2026 1:40 pm - 2:00 pm, settle 11/6/2026, Liquidity Support, Nominal Coupons 1Mo to 2Y, maturity range 12/06/2026 - 11/05/2028, min $0, max $4 billion, and it is the LAST row of the schedule. Stays estimate on the two counts every sibling in this family documents: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and the confirming primary is the 11-04 operation announcement (preliminary CUSIP list 11:00am ET) rather than this document, checked 2026-09-08
notes: CANONICAL entry written 2026-09-08 by this event's own initial research, promoting the single proposal filed from the treasury-buyback-7y10y-2026-09-17 initial-research sweep. Ledger: docs/research/events/treasury-buyback-1mo2y-2026-11-05.md. THE FINDING, from Treasury's own operations data (fiscaldata buybacks_operations, 220 rows, plus buybacks_security_details for six operations, all plain curl HTTP 200, fetched direct 2026-09-08): THIS IS THE ONLY $4 BILLION SECTOR IN THE WHOLE PROGRAM THAT FILLS. Across all 41 $4B-capped operations ever run, 13 filled — and 8 of those 13 are this bucket, which is 8 for 8. The other four $4B sectors are 5 for 33 combined (3Y-5Y 4/9, 2Y-3Y 1/8, 5Y-7Y 0/8, 7Y-10Y 0/8). Including its $2B debut and one $30M exercise the bucket is 10 for 10 lifetime, on offer books of $16.5-69.0 billion. That settles the proposer's cap-parity correction at the level it was raised: at an IDENTICAL cap, an identical acceptance rule and an identical operation window, fill is ~100% here and ~15% everywhere else, so the binding constraint is the sector's price gap, never the published maximum. THREE CORRECTIONS THIS ENTRY OWNS, all against its own proposal note. (1) Cover is 6.95x-17.25x on the eight $4B operations, not '9x to 17x' — the low is 2025-02-12 ($27.780B offered), and the 9x floor came from reading the $2B debut's dollar offer as if it were a $4B ratio. (2) The 2026-03-02 $30 million operation is not evidence the cap floats: it is the ONLY nominal-coupon operation since the 2024 pilots with a sub-$1B cap and the ONLY operation in the entire 220-row series carrying max_nbr_offers of 3 rather than 9, which are small-value systems-test fingerprints, and it ran 26 days after a full $4B operation in the same refunding quarter. A materially lower announced maximum on 11-04 would be new information, not a repeat. (3) The proposal's placement caution is half right and inverted: the operation has ANCHORED to the refunding rather than drifting from it — days from the quarterly refunding statement run 7, 14, 7, 8, then 0, 1, 1 for the last three quarters, and 11-05 is +1, the fourth in that pattern. THE REAL RISK IS EXISTENCE, NOT PARAMETERS: the bucket has skipped exactly one quarterly slot since the program began, and it was the November 2025 slot (2025-08-19 to 2026-02-04, 169 days, while every other sector ran on cadence and two $12.5B 1Mo-2Y CASH MANAGEMENT operations ran instead on 2025-12-03 and 2025-12-11). This quarter has the same setup — cash-management front-end operations already ran 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-09. One skip in eight completed slots, mechanism unpublished. ONE THING THAT DOES NOT PORT FROM THE SIBLING: the eligible list is NOT derivable here. Its near end is not the schedule's stated window start and drifts (+1.8 to +8.3 months past the operation date across six reconstructed lists), and it jumped discontinuously between the 2026-05-07 and 2026-08-06 operations (2026-07-31 to 2027-04-15). Filed medium to match every buyback sibling in this calendar rather than the proposal's 'low', because the 11-04 announcement is both this event's first hard number and the first post-midterm, post-refunding read on whether the front-end program continues. Read-it-do-not-trade-it: symbols is empty, no house playbook is rates-keyed, and nothing on 11-05 is attributable — the refunding statement is 11-04 08:30 ET, the midterms are 11-03 and the October jobs report is 11-06. Estimate-labeled throughout; nothing here licenses an entry.
